Open the Query tab: what are the first five pages for a question, and where is the handbook section?
The reposts all look alike. Moving pages by their title only helps them, because their titles name the topic.
MMR takes the best page, then penalises pages that repeat what is already picked. Five copies of one post count as one.
MMR can only lift the handbook section if it is among the candidates: with five reposts in front of it, the window has to be bigger than five.
